system.timestamp.note: The program builds system lines in the message constructors of the session code (createSystemMessage and the other subtype builders), and the remote-session path rebuilds some from stream-json frames. timestamp is new Date().toISOString(), a clock-function string of the same form, or the timestamp string of the source message.

system.uuid.note: The program builds system lines in the message constructors of the session code (createSystemMessage and the other subtype builders), and the remote-session path rebuilds some from stream-json frames. uuid is crypto.randomUUID() (imported as h_ and _io), or the uuid string of the frame the line is rebuilt from.

system.level.note: The program builds system lines in the message constructors of the session code (createSystemMessage and the other subtype builders), and the remote-session path rebuilds some from stream-json frames. system.scope.note: model_refusal_fallback lines: scope is the literal 'session' at one site, 'local' or 'session' at the other, and the optional scope of a stream frame (the stream-json schema: session|local).

system.trigger.note: model_refusal_fallback has trigger 'refusal'; model_fallback has the reason of the fallback (stream-json schema enum model_not_found|permission_denied|overloaded|server_error|last_resort|model_blocked).
